articles.title: Love, Suspicion, and a Knife: Dehradun MCA Student Arrested After Girlfriend Stabbed
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 21-year-old postgraduate student was arrested on Sunday for allegedly stabbing his girlfriend after a dispute over a suspected affair in the Clement Town area of Dehradun, police said. The accused, identified as Uday Singh alias Vishu, is a first-year MCA student at a private college.

body.html:
A 21-year-old postgraduate student was arrested on Sunday for allegedly stabbing his girlfriend after a dispute over a suspected affair in the Clement Town area of Dehradun, police said.

The accused, identified as Uday Singh alias Vishu, is a first-year MCA student at a private college. He was apprehended from the premises of Doon Hospital.

During interrogation, Singh, a native of Meerut, told police that he had been in a relationship with the woman since meeting her at college in September 2025 and wanted to marry her. However, he claimed he attacked her in a fit of rage after suspecting that she was involved with another man.

According to the police, the incident took place when the woman, also 21, visited Singh’s rented accommodation in the Ogal Bhatta area to speak with him. The argument allegedly escalated, during which Singh attacked her with a knife.

Both the accused and the victim were admitted to Doon Hospital on Saturday following the incident.

The victim’s father, Krishna Chandra Verma, later lodged a complaint alleging that Singh attacked his daughter with the intention of killing her.

Police said the woman suffered a deep wound to her neck and underwent surgery. Her condition remains critical.

A case has been registered against the accused under relevant sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita. The knife used in the attack has been recovered, and further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Bike Rider and Two Children Fall Into Open Drain in Pilkhuwa; CCTV Exposes Civic Negligence
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A case highlighting alleged municipal negligence has surfaced in Pilkhuwa town of Hapur district in Uttar Pradesh, where a bike rider and his two children fell into an open drain on a busy market road. The incident was captured on a nearby CCTV camera (8 March 2026).

body.html:
A case highlighting alleged municipal negligence has surfaced in Pilkhuwa town of Hapur district in Uttar Pradesh, where a bike rider and his two children fell into an open drain on a busy market road. The incident was captured on a nearby CCTV camera (8 March 2026).

According to eyewitnesses, the man was riding toward the market with his children when the motorcycle suddenly lost balance near an uncovered drain on the roadside close to Gandhi Bazaar. As a result, all three fell into the drain, causing panic in the area.

Local shopkeepers and passersby rushed to the spot and immediately started rescue efforts. After considerable effort, the man and both children were safely pulled out of the drain.

Fortunately, no fatalities were reported, though the bike rider and the two children sustained minor injuries in the accident.

CCTV footage of the incident shows the motorcycle suddenly veering toward the roadside before the rider and children fall into the open drain. The video has since raised serious concerns among residents about civic safety.

Following the incident, locals have questioned the functioning of the municipal authorities, saying that leaving drains uncovered in a busy market area poses a serious risk to public safety.

Residents have demanded that the municipal administration immediately cover open drains and implement proper safety measures to prevent similar accidents in the future.

articles.title: Mob Assaults Temple Priest in Kanpur After Photo Controversy; Police Rescue Victim
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A temple priest was allegedly assaulted by a mob inside a temple in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, after a photograph circulated on social media allegedly showing him eating non-vegetarian food.

body.html:
A temple priest was allegedly assaulted by a mob inside a temple in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, after a photograph circulated on social media allegedly showing him eating non-vegetarian food.

The incident occurred late Sunday (8 March 2026) night at the Bhuteshwar Temple in the Keshavpuram area under the jurisdiction of Rawatpur Police Station. According to reports, a crowd of around 50–60 people gathered at the temple premises following the circulation of the photo online.

The priest, identified as Prashant Giri, also known as Golu Pandit, serves as a priest and Mahant at the temple and lives in a room within the temple complex. Locals alleged that the viral photo showed him eating non-vegetarian food, which they claimed violated religious norms associated with the temple.

Enraged residents reportedly reached the temple late at night and confronted the priest. According to eyewitness accounts, the crowd pushed him out of his room and began assaulting him inside the temple premises. Some members of the mob were seen slapping him and shouting threats while others called for him to be dragged and beaten.

During the incident, two women intervened and attempted to shield the priest, sitting around him and pleading with the crowd to stop the attack. Despite their efforts, the mob continued to beat him, leaving him with multiple injuries.

The priest told police that the photograph circulating online had been edited to defame him, alleging that some individuals were conspiring to remove him from his position at the temple. He claimed that an old photograph from his restaurant had been manipulated to falsely show him consuming non-vegetarian food.

After receiving an emergency call on 112, police from Rawatpur Police Station arrived at the scene, rescued the injured priest from the mob, and brought him to the police station.

Station in-charge Kamlesh Rai confirmed that the priest was safely rescued from the crowd. The victim later filed a complaint at the police station.

Police said that videos of the assault have surfaced, and investigators are reviewing the footage to identify those involved. Authorities stated that appropriate legal action will be taken against the accused after the investigation.

articles.title: Muslim Cleric Brutally Assaulted in Muzaffarnagar; Police Arrest One, Search On for Others
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Tension gripped the Sarwat locality of Muzaffarnagar in Uttar Pradesh after a 28-year-old Muslim cleric, Mufti Abdul Wahab, was allegedly attacked by a group of youths on March 8, 2026.

body.html:
Tension gripped the Sarwat locality of Muzaffarnagar in Uttar Pradesh after a 28-year-old Muslim cleric, Mufti Abdul Wahab, was allegedly attacked by a group of youths on March 8, 2026.

According to reports, the victim—identified as Abdul Wahab—was returning home after offering prayers at the Peer Wali Masjid when several local youths allegedly stopped him on the way and assaulted him following a minor dispute.

The victim’s uncle Saeed Ahmed alleged that the accused—identified as Lavi, Basant, Harish, Aditya, and Rishabh—surrounded Wahab and attacked him with bats and hockey sticks, leaving him severely injured. The attackers reportedly fled the scene when bystanders and shopkeepers gathered.

Wahab suffered serious head injuries and collapsed on the road. He was rushed to a hospital, where he is currently undergoing treatment.

After receiving information about the incident, Siddharth K. Mishra, Additional Superintendent of Police (ASP), reached the spot with a police force and reviewed the situation. Police also increased security in the area to prevent tension from escalating.

Police Register Case

Police said the incident occurred between 12 p.m. and 1 p.m. and preliminary investigation suggests that a street altercation escalated into violence. CCTV footage from the area is being examined and statements of eyewitnesses are being recorded.

Based on the victim’s complaint, police have registered a case under relevant sections at the Civil Lines Police Station.

ASP Siddharth K. Mishra confirmed that police have named five accused in the case. One suspect, Lavi, has been arrested, while search operations are underway to trace the remaining accused.

Organization Condemns Attack

The incident has been condemned by the Jamiat Ulema-e-Hind, which described the assault as a serious and provocative act and demanded strict legal action against those responsible.

Police said strict action will be taken once the investigation is completed.

articles.title: UP: Panchayat Officer Suspended After Video Shows Alleged ₹2,000 Bribe for Birth Certificate
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Uttar Pradesh | Siddharthnagar – A video has surfaced showing a village panchayat officer in Itwa block allegedly accepting a ₹2,000 bribe for issuing a birth certificate.

body.html:
Uttar Pradesh | Siddharthnagar – A video has surfaced showing a village panchayat officer in Itwa block allegedly accepting a ₹2,000 bribe for issuing a birth certificate. The footage, which emerged on March 7, shows the officer taking four ₹500 notes from a youth and putting the money in his pocket.

In the video, the youth can be heard requesting the officer to process his file the same day, while another person filming says, “Look sir, otherwise you’ll say it’s only ₹500… I’ve given ₹2,000.”

The complaint was filed by Mohammad Shaban, a resident of Pirella village, who accused Gram Panchayat Officer Harendra Pandey of demanding ₹3,000 to process his birth certificate application. Shaban alleged he paid the money due to repeated delays and fear of harassment, even though no government fee is required for issuing a birth certificate.

The complaint further claims the officer allegedly demanded ₹2,000–₹3,000 per file and even ₹10,000–₹15,000 for fraudulent birth certificates. It also alleges that the officer used a private room inside the block premises to meet people and collect money.

Following the complaint and viral video, District Magistrate Shivasharanappa GN has suspended Harendra Pandey with immediate effect, while Chief Development Officer Balram Singh confirmed that an investigation is underway. The complainant has also requested action under the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 (amended 2018).

articles.title: UP: Masked Gunmen Rob ₹2.24 Lakh From Mobile Showroom in Aligarh, CCTV Footage Surfaces
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Two masked criminals carried out a daring robbery at a mobile showroom in broad daylight in Aligarh, Uttar Pradesh, escaping with cash worth over ₹2.24 lakh, police said. The incident took place near Chharra Adda bridge in the jurisdiction of Gandhi Park Police Station.

body.html:
Two masked criminals carried out a daring robbery at a mobile showroom in broad daylight in Aligarh, Uttar Pradesh, escaping with cash worth over ₹2.24 lakh, police said.

The incident took place near Chharra Adda bridge in the jurisdiction of Gandhi Park Police Station. According to reports, the two miscreants suddenly entered the showroom, brandished a pistol and threatened the employees and people present inside.

The robbers allegedly forced the staff at gunpoint and took cash from the cash box before fleeing the spot. The entire incident was captured on CCTV cameras installed inside the showroom.

Showroom owner Prashant Varshney and partner Bharat said the criminals threatened everyone in the shop and even attempted to intimidate them by threatening to kill them. At the time of the incident, the owner’s father and elder brother were also present in the showroom.

After receiving information about the robbery, Kamlesh Kumar, Circle Officer-II, reached the spot along with police personnel and began an investigation.

Police are examining CCTV footage from the showroom and nearby areas to identify the suspects. Officials said three police teams and a surveillance unit have been formed to track down the accused.

According to police, the criminals fled immediately after taking the cash, and efforts are underway to identify and arrest them.

articles.title: Cannon Fired From Raisen Fort, ‘Pro-Iran’ Slogans in Viral Video Spark Row in Madhya Pradesh
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video showing youths firing a cannon and allegedly raising pro-Iran slogans from the historic Raisen Fort in Raisen district of Madhya Pradesh has gone viral on social media, triggering controversy and prompting an official inquiry.

body.html:
A video showing youths firing a cannon and allegedly raising pro-Iran slogans from the historic Raisen Fort in Raisen district of Madhya Pradesh has gone viral on social media, triggering controversy and prompting an official inquiry.

According to reports, the youths had gathered at the fort’s ramparts during Ramadan to fire a cannon traditionally used to signal the time for Iftar (breaking the fast). However, in the viral video, some of the youths are allegedly heard shouting slogans expressing support for Iran while recording a reel.

The video quickly spread online and drew objections from authorities as well as members of the National Human Rights Commission.

NHRC member Priyank Kanoongo raised concerns over the incident on social media, alleging that firing an illegal indigenous cannon from a protected archaeological site could endanger civilian lives and damage heritage structures. He also questioned the role of officials from the Archaeological Survey of India and the local administration, stating that strict action should be taken if laws were violated.

Kanoongo further said that notices are being prepared seeking action and accountability from officials if negligence is found.

Following the controversy, local authorities confirmed that the matter is under investigation. Bharat Mandre, Tehsildar of Raisen, said the viral video has been forwarded to the Kotwali Police Station Raisen for verification and necessary legal action.

Police have reportedly arrested Shadaab Qureshi, Yusuf Sheikh, Wasim Mohammad, and Salman Qureshi in connection with the incident.

Officials said that the cannon is traditionally fired during Ramadan to announce Suhoor and Iftar timings, for which a temporary licence is sometimes issued by the administration for about a month. Authorities are now verifying whether the cannon used in the video was legally permitted and whether any laws were violated.

The administration is also examining the authenticity of the viral clip, as claims have emerged that older videos may have been included in the social media post.

articles.title: Holi Visit Turns Deadly: Ex-Google Engineer Stabs Twin Sister 40+ Times in Moradabad, Attacks Mother
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking murder case has surfaced from Moradabad in Uttar Pradesh, where a 25-year-old engineer allegedly stabbed his twin sister to death and attacked his mother while visiting home for Holi.

body.html:
A shocking murder case has surfaced from Moradabad in Uttar Pradesh, where a 25-year-old engineer allegedly stabbed his twin sister to death and attacked his mother while visiting home for Holi.

The accused, Hardik (25), had previously worked at Google but left his job about a year ago to become a YouTuber. His twin sister Himshikha (25) worked as an assistant manager at an IT company in Gurugram and was also pursuing an MBA.

According to police, the siblings had come to Moradabad on March 3 to celebrate Holi with their mother Neelima, who lives in Buddhi Vihar Sector-2 under the jurisdiction of Majhola Police Station.

Police said that on Friday, before their planned return to Haryana, an argument broke out between the siblings. In a fit of rage, Hardik allegedly stabbed Himshikha more than 40 times on the neck, face and body, killing her on the spot. He then wrapped the body in a blanket and locked the house gate from outside.

As per the injured mother’s statement, Hardik later brought her home from her office on the pretext of leaving for Haryana urgently. When Neelima saw her daughter’s body wrapped in a blanket in the courtyard, she began screaming, after which Hardik allegedly attacked her with a knife.

Hearing the commotion, neighbours rushed to the spot while the accused fled in a car before police arrived.

Both victims were taken to the district hospital, where doctors declared Himshikha dead. Neelima is currently undergoing treatment.

Investigators said Hardik was reportedly in a relationship with a girl from another community and wanted to marry her, but his mother and sister opposed it. Police believe the dispute may have triggered the attack.

Superintendent of Police (City) Kumar Ranvijay Singh said the accused initially fled towards Delhi. After checking CCTV footage and alerting nearby districts and toll checkpoints, police later arrested him and sent him to jail. Further interrogation is underway.

The brutal incident has shocked residents of the Buddhi Vihar area.
